title: a friend of mine / my own house / on my own / by myself
subtitle: Один из моих друзей, свой собственный, в одиночку

theory.text: «Один из моих друзей» — a friend of mine (не a friend of me). Так же: of yours, of his, of hers, of ours, of theirs, а с именем — a colleague of my father's.

items: my own room, her own business, their own house — только моё, не общее и не чужое. Нельзя an own room.
Можно и так: a house of my own, problems of his own.
own = сам делаю для себя: He grows his own vegetables. She makes her own clothes.

theory.text: on my own / by myself — один, в одиночку
My grandmother lives on her own = My grandmother lives by herself.
Типичные ошибки: a friend of me (надо of mine), by my own (надо on my own или by myself) и I have own car (надо my own car).
